questions.question: The term 'Civics' is derived from which Latin words?
questions.explanation: Civis means citizen and civitas means city-state in Latin.

questions.question: Which of the following is an indispensable element of the state?
questions.explanation: The four essential elements of a state are population, territory, government, and sovereignty.

questions.question: Which pillar is fundamental to Good Governance (Su-shashon)?
questions.explanation: Transparency, accountability, rule of law, and responsiveness are core pillars of good governance.

questions.question: What is the primary distinguishing mark of a citizen from an alien?
questions.explanation: Citizens enjoy full political rights including franchise, whereas aliens do not possess voting rights.

questions.question: Rule of law means:

options.label: A
options.text: The ruler's command is supreme above all

options.label: B
options.text: All citizens are equal in the eyes of law

questions.correct_answer_text: All citizens are equal in the eyes of law
questions.explanation: A.V. Dicey defined rule of law as supremacy of regular law and equality before the law without arbitrary privilege.
